newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-UNITED'S FERGUSON INTERESTED IN DEFENDER HIERRO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNITED'S FERGUSON INTERESTED IN DEFENDER HIERRO.

text.p: Manchester United coach Alex Ferguson has denied that his club is interested in Real Madrid strikers Predrag Mijatovic and Davor Suker, but acknowledged that he is keen on Real defender Fernando Hierro.

"He's a player that we like a lot for his flexibility and character on the field ... the only problem is that Real don't want to sell him," said Ferguson in an interview published by the sports daily 'Marca' on Thursday.
Ferguson accused the representatives of Suker and Mijatovic of creating a rumour which linked them to both United and Arsenal as a way of "raising the price of the product."
Real chairman Lorenzo Sanz has reacted philosophically to reports of the five billion pesetas ($38.2 million) bid for his Balkan strike force.

"In business terms it's good -- from two billion pesetas ($15.3 million) to five billion in six months. But in sports terms it's bad," said Sanz, referring to the amount paid for the forwards in the close-season.
